0022600122.text: The Miami Heat (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) host the Dallas Mavericks (1-2) in the fourth game of the Heat's season, with Miami 15th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, 2 games back. Dallas, 12th in the West and 2 games back in the Southwest, is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee), Santi Aldama (knee surgery) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the most recent meeting a 118-108 Heat loss in Dallas on December 3, 2025.
